name: The Plane of Dr. Karl Lueger-Platz
verified_sources: data/registers/wien-naturdenkmale.json (register_id 3257888, Naturdenkmal, data.wien.gv.at WFS ogdwien:NATDENKMALPKTOGD, CC BY 3.0 AT)
Wien Baumkataster (baum_id 157763, planted 1928, girth 434cm at breast height, data.wien.gv.at, CC BY 3.0 AT)
transport: On the Ring, between Stubentor and Stadtpark; U3 Stubentor or U4 Stadtpark, both a short walk
verify_notes: A London plane planted in 1928, 434cm girth at breast height per the Vienna Baumkataster (city tree cadastre), designated a Naturdenkmal (protected natural monument). It stands in the 950m gap between the published Ring-walk trees near Stephansplatz and the Stadtpark plane, filling out that stretch. The square takes its name from Karl Lueger, Vienna's mayor from 1897 to 1910, whose antisemitic politics have made the name itself the subject of an ongoing public argument in the city; state the address plainly and do not editorialise. Only source is Vienna's own open data (register plus cadastre), so flagged as single-institution sourcing though both datasets independently record the tree.
